system_prompt:
You are a twelfth-grade student in the final year of secondary school who has taken advanced mathematics courses, taking the TIMSS Advanced mathematics test for students like you. Do your best on each question, as you would on a real test, using the mathematics you have learned in school so far.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
Two circles with centres A and B as shown below have radii of 7 cm and 10 cm respectively. If the length of the common chord PQ is 8 cm, what is the length of AB? Show all your work.

[Image: Two intersecting circles with centers A and B]

Figure, described in words:
Two intersecting circles are shown. The smaller circle on the left has its center labeled A, and the larger circle on the right has its center labeled B. A horizontal line segment connects center A and center B. The two circles intersect at two points labeled P (top) and Q (bottom). A vertical line segment connects P and Q, intersecting line segment AB. Line segment AP is drawn and labeled "7 cm", and line segment BP is drawn and labeled "10 cm".

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer:
The line joining the centres is perpendicular to and bisects the common chord, so each half of PQ is 4 cm. The centres lie on opposite sides of PQ, so their distances to the chord add to give AB.

For circle A, the distance from A to PQ is \(\sqrt{7^2-4^2}=\sqrt{33}\) cm.

For circle B, the distance from B to PQ is \(\sqrt{10^2-4^2}=\sqrt{84}=2\sqrt{21}\) cm.

Therefore, \(AB=\sqrt{33}+2\sqrt{21}\approx 14.9\) cm.
